title: The Castle Holds
tagline: A tower defence for one or two players where you program each defender by wiring cards: if the enemy is big, crossbow; else, arrow.
readinessNote: Plays end to end: stages, waves, a village to build, recruits, machines, and a castle that grows or collapses. Enemy, weapon, building and cosmetic stats are tables at the top of the script, but waves come from a formula (waveFor) and every stage rule is in one 185 KB file; split it and make a wave format first.
buildYourOwn: Monsters, weapons, conditions for the boards, buildings, outfits and mounts, hand-made waves, new castle parts.
controls: Mouse or touch; keyboard for camera views and walking a villager
